provenance.made_with: Written by Sabik with help from OpenAI Codex (SI). See AI_USE.md.
provenance.method: Visual inspection of the original NASA frame, supported by pixel-boundary checks; no image modification.

date_panel.boundary_observations: Left-edge pixels first change from blue at row 1852. Bottom row changes from the shaded panel at x 676. Rounded panel corner means not every pixel inside the bounding rectangle is covered.

decision: Ky-supplied coordinates are clear of the previously inspected date panel. All 72 NDVI source frames also pass the exporter dimension and sample-window guards.
limitations: Only this one frame was visually inspected; this does not verify the layout of every historical frame.
Layout clearance does not validate physical NDVI values; the pipeline extracts relative colourbar positions only.
Recheck any added location or changed source layout before export.
